relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
Marco semántico común de una intersección
Tacit Knowledge Management in Distributed Tiger Teams
relations.reading: Cross-border knowledge transfer includes the ability to handle local exceptions, not merely the movement of manuals or personnel.

relations.title: The Attribution Gap and Capability Loss
relations.reading: The corridor invites a bounded attribution study of where a capability is created, maintained and capitalized, rather than inferring its value from the location that books the revenue.

relations.title: Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: A cross-border follow-up should establish whether the same capability was retained, transferred, duplicated or lost before applying an attribution-gap explanation.

relations.title: JubAp.Net GEPLAN and the Hidden Logistics Lab Behind PEMEX Operations
relations.reading: The regional supplier fabric can be read alongside GEPLAN's field laboratory as capability formation through repeated operational problems, not simply technology adoption from outside.

relations.title: Case Study: Texas-to-Mexico Oilfield Services Transformation: Knowledge Transfer, Industrialization, and Compliance
relations.reading: The Texas-to-Mexico case makes regional capability formation tangible through local roles, acceptance criteria and operating records that let the receiving team execute in its own context.

relations.title: Case Study: Chicontepec Megaproject
relations.reading: Field capability and programme performance belong to different levels; the Chicontepec integration case adds the contractual, territorial and governance conditions between them.

relations.title: Supply Chain Rationalization & Process Mining
relations.reading: Field workarounds become more informative when linked to process traces that show their trigger, authorization and effect on the receiving operation.

relations.title: From Field Practice to Pre-Standardization: An Extensible Case-Study Framework
relations.reading: The case-study framework can preserve the field observation as evidence while recording the migration interpretation as a separate, testable layer with its own data requirements.

relations.title: Instituciones de frontera: Cuando emprender es construir un puente entre mundos.
relations.reading: The industrial-corridor account offers a way to examine dual embeddedness through actual translation of operating requirements, rather than geography alone.

relations.title: Petroleo no Convencional. Afectación al paisaje y ecosistema superficial en el Proyecto Chicontepec
relations.reading: The historical Chicontepec account helps separate local capability formation from programme-level and territorial outcomes; improvement at one level cannot stand in for the others.

relations.title: Structural Awareness — Common Blind-Spot Cartography and Opportunity Arrival
relations.reading: Distributed field observations can be combined meaningfully only after their question, event, scope and time references have been aligned.
